# meshmsg v0.1.20

This patch release is a logging telemetry and documentation cleanup after v0.1.19.

## Changes

- Adds `meshmsg diagnostics` with separately negotiated strict `diagnostic_status_v3`, where daemon-output errors rejected before queue admission are reported as `admission_rejections` rather than counted as queue drops.
- Preserves the exact v0.1.19 `diagnostic_status_v2` capability and response schema. Current clients prefer v3 and intentionally fall back to v2, while current daemons serve both versions.
- Clarifies that local diagnostics retain metadata only and no private causes.
- Narrows the documented test evidence to the signed-network-event rejection path actually covered.

## Compatibility

There are no message-wire or persistent-state format changes in this release. The v0.1.19 diagnostic status v2 contract remains unchanged in both directions; clients that want the new admission metric must negotiate `diagnostic_status_v3`. Mixed v0.1.19/current daemon and client operation remains supported through v2.

Install this exact source release after the `v0.1.20` tag is published:

```sh
cargo install --git https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg \
  --tag v0.1.20 --locked --force
```

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg/compare/v0.1.19...v0.1.20
